ja: • 2200系の増備用として新造した戦後関西発の通勤冷房車。屋上に小型ユニットクーラー８台を搭載し、大型MGを初めて採用。
• 1988年から1990年にかけて内装リニューアル、制御装置の添加励磁・回生ブレーキ化および補助電源装置のSIV化などの車体改修工事を実施。
• 先頭車（更新後タイプ）＋中間車の２両セット。
• ステッカー付属。NEW SGフレーム。
en: • A newly built air-conditioned commuter car from the Kansai region after the war as an addition to the 2200 series. Equipped with eight small unit coolers on the roof, this is the first time a large MG has been used.

• From 1988 to 1990, body modification work was carried out, including interior renewal, addition of excitation and regenerative braking to the control device, and SIV conversion to the auxiliary power supply.
• 2-car set: leading car (updated type) + middle car.
